body.voice_description: Design an original voice for a small friendly chess-coach character. Natural and understated, a smooth androgynous middle speaking register with neutral American English. Soft matte vocal texture, intimate but fully voiced, short thoughtful observations and a subtle smile. Sound like a real approachable person explaining one useful idea, not a comedy creature. Comfortable even phrasing and warm clarity. No high squeak, rubbery vowels, nasal cartoon buzz, comic wobble, silly exclamations or theatrical pitch changes. Fluent English at a normal conversational teaching pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Notice what changed. That piece lost its defender. The other side can take it now. Keep the idea simple: look after your pieces.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
